intended_object: The canonical natural map P → P⁺⁺ from a presheaf to its plus-plus sheafification (Grothendieck's plus construction applied twice). Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module (ConcreteSheafification).
explanation: The definition composes the canonical map P → P⁺ (toPlusNatTrans) with the same map whiskered by the plus functor (P⁺ → P⁺⁺). This gives the natural transformation 𝟭 ⟶ plusFunctor ⋙ plusFunctor, which matches sheafification J D assuming it is defined as the plus functor applied twice; I did not recheck that definition in the source. This is exactly the standard unit of the plus-plus construction. Its hypotheses (multiequalizers for each cover, colimits over each opposite category of covers) are precisely what the plus construction needs. The abstract sheafification unit CategoryTheory.toSheafify is the general counterpart, but this definition is specifically the concrete plus-plus version, so its setting is intrinsic to its content.
